name: multi-panel-dock
title: Multi Panel Dock
description: IDE layout with main coding editor above and collapsible developer console drawer docked below.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Dockable Console Drawer: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
